preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array a must be positive integers between 1 and 10^6.
The length of the array a must be exactly 2n for each test case.

postconditions.description: The output must start with 'YES' if it is possible to throw out all elements, or 'NO' otherwise.
The output must contain 'YES' exactly t times for the test cases where it is possible.

postconditions.expression: any(int(x) == int(y) for x, y in zip(stdout.split()[1::2], stdout.split()[2::2]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the pairs of integers removed must be valid and sum to the initial x.
